title: Gold Fringe? Does it mean Maritime Jurisdiction?
summary: Rebuts a gold-fringe admiralty claim by reading the actual court decision and a 1925 Attorney General opinion that fringe has no legal significance.

assertions.quote: presence of yellow Fringe on American flag did not turn such flag into a flag of war
they think just because the quote is in the text that it must be the gospel

verdicts.note: Judges and researchers note pseudolaw promoters routinely cite case passages out of context or from party arguments.
OPCA applicants often cite cases that say the opposite (McMillan) or are irrelevant, which shows misreading in general but not the specific recited-facts mechanism.

assertions.quote: jurisdiction is a matter of law statutes and Constitution not a child's game
